notes: S1-FIX4 W1 / S1-FIX5 X2 (§11.5 rule 3; docs/open-questions.md §6 entry 24, decision 2026-11-12 #1): the target is an L2 container whose trusted receipt (genTime T0) rescues the device declaration from a key-compromise revocation effective at T1, so both records are valid. The previous manifest, signed by the compromised key, has created_at 2025-01-01, before T1. On the previous link a key-compromise revocation is judged like a retired one, against the previous created_at: its digest is already pinned by the target's trusted signature, so a compromise that takes effect later does not reach back into the link. The link holds (L_PREVIOUS_CONTENT_UNVERIFIED; the equation used context material, L_KEY_TRUST_TOFU), the timestamp phase runs and the receipt is verified: valid (a claimed L2 chain is never recomputed offline: L_CHAIN_CLAIM_UNVERIFIED).
